name: The Pause
habit: 5 min of cyclic sighing every morning
when: After my first coffee, I breathe for 5 minutes: two inhales through the nose, one long exhale.

name: Iron Sleep
habit: Same wake time every day, 7.5 h in bed
when: When it is 30 minutes before bed, my phone leaves the bedroom.

name: Few Words
habit: 5 min voice drill, answer in one sentence first
when: When someone asks me a question, I answer in one sentence, then pause.

name: Stillness
habit: 10 min of sitting meditation
when: After training, I sit for 10 minutes before I touch my phone.

name: Review
habit: Score every habit 1 to 10, write a letter to yourself, take photos
when: In the first week, I book the DEXA scan and the review evening.

name: Say It
habit: One true thing a week, said out loud
when: On Sunday evening, I tell someone I trust one thing I have been carrying.

name: Counsel
habit: One session a month with your Mimir
when: On the 1st of each month, I book a mentor, coach or therapist.

name: Ask First
habit: A question before advice
when: When someone brings me a problem, I ask one question before I answer.

name: Mercy First
habit: Their view before yours
when: When I disagree, I say their view back before I give mine.

name: Review
habit: Score every habit 1 to 10, write a letter to yourself, take photos
when: In the first week, I book the DEXA scan and the review evening.

name: Teach
habit: Teach one thing a week
when: Every Friday, I teach one thing I know: a client, a post, a friend.

name: Serve
habit: One act of service nobody asked for
when: When I see a job someone dreads, I do it without saying so.

name: Face It
habit: One avoided thing a month, in small steps
when: On the 1st, I pick the next small step toward something I avoid, and I take it with support.

name: Build
habit: One project for others
when: Every month, I give one free session or resource to people who cannot pay.

name: Mentor One
habit: Mentor one person every month
when: On the last Sunday of the month, I call the person I mentor.

name: Your Code
habit: Write the code you live by, on one page
when: When the season ends, my one-page code is printed and on the wall.

name: Return
habit: Rebuild your weakest habit
when: At the start of the season, I pick the habit with the lowest score and restart it.

name: Keep
habit: Nothing new. Keep everything.
when: Every Sunday, I run the weekly review, whatever happened.
